publish_arming.note: Queue script creates DRAFTS unarmed. Conversion to a live schedule requires FAMTASTIC_MARKETING_PUBLISH=true on the operator host.

media_resolution.note: Video assets are gitignored (.gitignore: *.mp4) and exist only on the operator workstation. A drop whose primary media is missing is reported BLOCKED with the expected path; it is never posted image-only by fallback and never skipped silently.
